contact_message_summary.description: Aggregated view of contact message statistics
contact_message_summary.sql: SELECT c.id, c.phone, c.name, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.business, COUNT(m.guid) as total_messages, SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_from_me = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as messages_sent, SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_from_me = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as messages_received, MAX(m.timestamp) as last_message_timestamp FROM contacts c LEFT JOIN messages m ON c.phone = m.phone_number GROUP BY c.id, c.phone, c.name

group_members.description: View showing group membership with contact details
group_members.sql: SELECT g.id as group_id, g.name as group_name, c.id as contact_id, c.phone, c.name as contact_name, c.business FROM groups g JOIN json_each(g.member_phones) as phones ON phones.value = c.phone JOIN contacts c ON c.phone = phones.value

recent_messages.description: View of recent messages with contact information
recent_messages.sql: SELECT m.guid, m.body, m.timestamp, m.is_from_me, c.name as contact_name, c.phone, c.business FROM messages m LEFT JOIN contacts c ON m.contact_id = c.id ORDER BY m.timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

invite_summary.description: View of invites with contact information and completion status
invite_summary.sql: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.description, i.creation_date, i.due_date, i.completed, i.completion_status, i.priority, i.sent_received, i.to_phone, i.from_phone, c_to.name as to_contact_name, c_from.name as from_contact_name FROM invites i LEFT JOIN contacts c_to ON i.to_phone = c_to.phone LEFT JOIN contacts c_from ON i.from_phone = c_from.phone

pending_invites.description: View of all pending invites ordered by priority and due date
pending_invites.sql: SELECT i.*, c_to.name as to_contact_name, c_from.name as from_contact_name FROM invites i LEFT JOIN contacts c_to ON i.to_phone = c_to.phone LEFT JOIN contacts c_from ON i.from_phone = c_from.phone WHERE i.completed = 0 ORDER BY i.priority DESC, i.due_date ASC

recurring_invites.description: View of recurring invites with their next occurrence information
recurring_invites.sql: SELECT i.*, c_to.name as to_contact_name, c_from.name as from_contact_name FROM invites i LEFT JOIN contacts c_to ON i.to_phone = c_to.phone LEFT JOIN contacts c_from ON i.from_phone = c_from.phone WHERE i.is_recurring = 1 ORDER BY i.recurrence_type, i.creation_date

update_contact_message_stats.description: Automatically update contact message statistics when messages are inserted/updated
update_contact_message_stats.sql: UPDATE contacts SET total_messages = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE contact_id = NEW.contact_id), messages_sent = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE contact_id = NEW.contact_id AND is_from_me = 1), messages_received = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE contact_id = NEW.contact_id AND is_from_me = 0), last_message_date = datetime(NEW.timestamp, 'unixepoch') WHERE id = NEW.contact_id

update_group_member_count.description: Update group metadata when members are added/removed
update_group_member_count.sql: UPDATE groups SET metadata = json_set(metadata, '$.member_count', json_array_length(member_phones)) WHERE id = NEW.id

update_invite_completion.description: Automatically set completion date when invite is marked as completed
update_invite_completion.sql: UPDATE invites SET date_completed = CASE WHEN NEW.completed = 1 AND OLD.completed = 0 THEN datetime('now') ELSE NEW.date_completed END, last_modified_date = datetime('now') WHERE id = NEW.id

update_invite_modified_date.description: Automatically update last_modified_date on any invite update
update_invite_modified_date.sql: UPDATE invites SET last_modified_date = datetime('now') WHERE id = NEW.id

data_integrity: Phone numbers must be unique across all contacts
Message GUIDs must be unique across all messages
Group IDs must be valid UUIDs
Canvas node positions must be within reasonable bounds
Contact references in messages must exist in contacts table
Invite IDs must be valid UUIDs
Invite phone number references must exist in contacts table
Message origin GUIDs must exist in messages table
Recurring task references must be valid invite UUIDs
business_rules: Primary user contacts should have is_primary_user = 1
Message timestamps should be in Unix epoch format
Group member phones must reference valid contact phone numbers
Canvas nodes must reference valid contact phone numbers
Invite completion status should be consistent with completed boolean
Recurring tasks should have valid recurrence_type values
Priority levels should be between 1 and 5
AI confidence scores should be between 0.0 and 1.0
Sent/received field must be either 'sent' or 'received'

migration_notes: The contacts table includes legacy contact_group field for backward compatibility
Profile photos are stored as BLOB data for performance
JSON fields are used for flexible metadata storage in groups and canvas data
Message timestamps are stored as integers for efficient querying
Foreign key relationships use phone numbers as business keys for contacts
Invites table uses UUIDs for primary keys to support distributed systems
Recurring tasks use self-referencing foreign keys for task chains
AI analysis data is stored as JSON for flexible schema evolution
Task hierarchies are stored as JSON arrays for efficient querying
performance_considerations: Indexes are created on frequently queried columns
Message history uses efficient timestamp-based queries
Contact lookups are optimized with phone number indexing
Canvas data uses JSON for flexible storage of complex structures
Profile photos are stored as BLOB for fast retrieval
Invites are indexed by priority, due date, and completion status for efficient filtering
Recurring task queries are optimized with dedicated indexes
AI analysis results are cached to avoid repeated processing
Task hierarchies use JSON for flexible parent-child relationships
backup_recommendations: Regular SQLite database backups should be performed
Profile photos should be backed up separately if large
Canvas state should be exported to JSON for portability
Message history should be archived periodically for performance
Invites data should be backed up with full JSON field integrity
AI analysis results should be preserved in backups for continuity
Recurring task chains should be validated after restore operations
